name: Outcome Case Study
tagline: A cyan-and-deep-teal customer case study with a photographic cover, intervention map, rollout, before/after evidence and outcome scorecard.

palette.description: Deep teal and bright cyan over clean off-white, with a full-width service photograph.

typography.style: Heavy geometric display headlines paired with clear human-centered case-study narration.

best_for: Customer outcome stories that show context, challenge, intervention, implementation and quantified proof.
avoid_for: Cases without consented evidence or quotes, highly technical incident analysis, or academic literature reviews.
